posts.title: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope Enters Final Commissioning Phase
posts.lead: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope mission has now entered the science commissioning phase, having successfully completed a comprehensive checkout and refinement of the observatory and primary instrument performance.

posts.title: NASA Roman Team Checks Out Main Instrument, Sharpens Telescope’s Focus
posts.lead: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope team completed a marathon of activities to fine-tune the observatory’s vision and prepare the primary instrument for routine use.

posts.title: NASA Checks Roman Guidance System, Takes First Coronagraph Observation
posts.lead: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope’s fine-guidance system, which allows the observatory to lock very steadily onto its targets during observations, passed a spate of tests from Sept. 15 to 21.

posts.title: NASA’s Roman Team Confirms Ground Stations Receiving Data
posts.lead: NASA has now confirmed all ground stations supporting the agency’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope are ready to receive the mission’s high volume of data once science operations begin by early 2027.

posts.title: NASA Activates Roman’s Primary Instrument, Checks Out Coronagraph
posts.lead: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope team has successfully activated the Wide Field Instrument, a 300-megapixel infrared camera that will allow scientists to explore wide swaths of the cosmos very quickly without sacrificing exquisite detail.

news.lead: NASA’s Parker Solar Probe completed its 29th close approach to the Sun on Sept. 4, again matching its record speed and distance from the solar surface.

news.title: NASA’s Parker Solar Probe Completes 26th Closest Approach to Sun
